title: Ravelry Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day ravelry metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on ravelry metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back what time of day your ravelry metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
